create_ExecutionContext: create an ExecutionContext dataclass instance with training_ddp_rank, using_ddp, and ddp_world_size fields
check_is_training_master: check if an ExecutionContext instance is the training master process using is_training_master property
check_is_training_helper: check if an ExecutionContext instance is a training helper process using is_training_helper property
check_is_rollouter: check if an ExecutionContext instance is a rollouter process using is_rollouter property
review_ExecutionContext: review the ExecutionContext frozen dataclass that identifies process roles in distributed training
